name: Single-cell integration and malignant meta-programs
purpose: Build a donor-auditable gastric atlas and derive recurrent malignant programs
input_contract: Raw/processed nonnegative counts plus immutable donor sample cohort state and treatment manifest
output_contract: QC report; donor/state table; malignant labels; program usage and spectra; stability and holdout metrics
notes: Author code is unavailable; rebuild from official Seurat/Scanpy/CopyKAT/cNMF components.

name: Spatial projection and niche validation
purpose: Map malignant and TME programs and test replicated neighborhoods
input_contract: Spatial matrix coordinates histology and frozen single-cell reference with patient/section IDs
output_contract: Per-section source tables; program maps; null/permutation statistics; independent replication
notes: Do not select and validate an ROI with the same co-enrichment statistic.

name: Foundation-model state perturbation
purpose: Prioritize genes that robustly shift prespecified gastric cell states
input_contract: Frozen counts/metadata; donor-disjoint source/target labels; pinned model/token dictionary
output_contract: Ranked perturbations with seed/split/state-definition stability nulls and simple baselines
notes: Model output is candidate prioritization, not causal knockout evidence.

name: Clinical projection and validation
purpose: Project frozen program signatures into independent survival and treatment cohorts
input_contract: Frozen gene sets plus expression, patient IDs, endpoints, treatment arms and covariates
output_contract: Patient-level source table; multivariable estimates; diagnostics; multiplicity and interaction results
notes: Do not use discovery-exposed outcomes as untouched external validation.

name: Foundation atlas QC integration and annotation
purpose: Build a donor-auditable normal polyp primary and metastatic CRC foundation atlas
input_contract: Traceable count layer plus immutable patient sample study platform tissue state and treatment manifest
output_contract: Per-sample QC and doublet receipts; integration metrics; author and reviewed labels; annotation evidence
notes: Author atlas code is an adapter donor; UMAP appearance and propagated author labels are not acceptance evidence.

name: Spatial primary-metastasis niche validation
purpose: Project programs across CRC and liver-metastasis sections
input_contract: Spatial matrices images coordinates and matched donor/site IDs
output_contract: Per-section maps; source tables; nulls; matched/independent replication
notes: Preoperative therapy is part of the design, not disposable metadata.

name: Foundation-model state perturbation
input_contract: Frozen counts/metadata; donor-disjoint labels; pinned model/token dictionary
output_contract: Stable ranked perturbations plus nulls and baselines
notes: A new model method does not by itself prevent publication duplication.

name: Clinical projection and validation
purpose: Project frozen programs into independent CRC outcome and treatment cohorts
input_contract: Frozen gene sets plus expression, patient IDs, endpoints, treatment arms and covariates
output_contract: Patient source table; multivariable estimates; diagnostics; interactions and external checks
notes: Cohorts used to define programs cannot be relabeled external validation.

name: Per-sample CNA malignancy inference
purpose: Classify epithelial cells with concordant CNA evidence while preserving unresolved and near-diploid tumors
input_contract: Per-sample raw nonnegative UMI; patient sample tissue reviewed epithelial labels and explicit normal-reference candidates
output_contract: CopyKAT and SCEVAN calls; CNA burden; method concordance; per-sample QC and three-level malignancy labels
notes: HCC supplies the evidence role only; implementation must be rebuilt and diploid cannot automatically mean nonmalignant.

name: Donor-stable malignant cNMF programs
purpose: Discover and freeze malignant programs that survive K seed sampling patient and dataset perturbations
input_contract: High-confidence malignant nonnegative counts; fixed gene universe; patient sample dataset state manifest and discovery-holdout split
output_contract: K diagnostics; spectra and usage; stability matches; patient and dataset mixing; merge membership and frozen programs
notes: CRC myeloid cNMF and HCC malignant cNMF are donors for interfaces and evidence roles; neither is a valid target implementation without repair.

name: ICC single-cell program pipeline
purpose: Derive recurrent ICC malignant programs and ecosystem states if data permit
input_contract: Nonnegative counts and complete donor/state manifest
output_contract: QC; malignant programs; donor/state results and stability
notes: Full module remains blocked until a qualifying dataset chain exists.

name: ICC spatial and clinical validation
purpose: Test any retained spatial and outcome claims
input_contract: Spatial and/or bulk data with independent patient IDs and complete endpoints
output_contract: Replicated spatial source tables and/or clinical model diagnostics
notes: Figure set must shrink if no dataset can complete the corresponding paper task.

name: ICC virtual perturbation
purpose: Prioritize candidate state shifts only after source/target states are robust
input_contract: Pinned model and donor-disjoint ICC cell states
output_contract: Stable rankings, nulls, baselines and orthogonal checks
notes: Not executable from the anchor's excluded ICC manifest alone.
